image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a vibrant metallic green tiger beetle on sandy soil. The beetle is positioned diagonally, facing right. It exhibits characteristic features including large compound eyes, long slender legs, and iridescent elytra with pale markings. There appears to be a second, partially obscured beetle or reflection immediately behind/under the primary subject, creating a complex overlapping structure.
